queries.title: NEAR IR | Revenue and emissions
queries.notes: NEAR-equivalent fees converted at daily prices; net receipts plus provider 70% gas-burn classification. Not tokenholder cash income or verified purchases.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Base-chain and token history
queries.notes: Different columns have different units. Account identities and locked-supply methodology remain provider-defined.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Intents activity history
queries.notes: Service notional, fees and swaps are separate measures. Gaps are NULL, not zero. Unique users are in the source scorecard, not summed daily counts.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Revenue scorecard
queries.notes: Original API fields and formatting. Revenue is the IR accounting definition, not distributable tokenholder earnings.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Ecosystem scorecard
queries.notes: Provider-reported users, swaps and supply. totalSwaps and cumulativeSwaps differ; no entity deduplication or supply-methodology reconciliation claimed.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Intents token and chain mix
queries.notes: Token symbols and blockchain labels are source labels. All-time referral fees remain a separate measure; never infer fee share from volume share.

queries.title: NEAR IR | Revenue wallets and fee channels
queries.notes: Two independent groups with different units and windows. Channel aggregate is not interchangeable with total Intents fees. Wallet labels are provider classifications, not verified receipts.
